subject: gk
question: Which of the following powers is NOT enjoyed by the Governor of a State?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Diplomatic/Military powers**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Governor of a state in India does not have any Diplomatic or Military powers.
 
• These powers are exclusively reserved for the President of India.
 
• The Governor's role is limited to the state level and does not extend to international or military affairs.
 
• Diplomatic powers include appointing ambassadors, entering into treaties, and conducting foreign relations, all of which are managed by the central government.
 
• Military powers include the command of the armed forces, which is vested in the President as the supreme commander.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Judiciary Powers of Governor:**

 
 
• The Governor has the power to grant pardons, reprieves, respites, or remission of punishment.
 
• He can also suspend, remit or commute the sentence of any person convicted of any offense against state laws.
 
 
 
• **Executive Powers of Governor:**
 
 
• The Governor appoints the Chief Minister and other ministers.
 
• He appoints the Advocate General and the State Election Commissioner.
 
• All executive actions of the state are taken in the name of the Governor.
 
 
 
• **Legislative Powers of Governor:**
 
 
• The Governor can summon, prorogue, and dissolve the state legislative assembly.
 
• He addresses the state legislature at the commencement of the first session after each general election.
 
• The Governor can reserve certain bills for the President's consideration.
 
 
 
• **Financial Powers of Governor:**
 
 
• The Governor ensures that the Annual Financial Statement (State Budget) is laid before the state legislature.
 
• No money bill can be introduced in the state legislature without the Governor's prior recommendation.
